question: Gold-backed paper money kaam kaise karta tha?
essence: Paper ki value uske material se nahi, fixed quantity of gold mein redemption ke promise se aati thi.
answer: Central bank gold reserves rakhta aur paper notes issue karta tha. Note-holder, principle mein, note dekar fixed amount of gold le sakta tha. Isliye note sirf kagaz nahi, gold redemption ka claim tha. Har note ko gold backing chahiye thi, isliye excessive printing par constraint tha. [p004]
deep_dive: Intrinsic value ka matlab material ki apni value hai; paper ki yeh value bahut kam thi. Note ki monetary value issuing authority ke gold dene ke promise par tikti thi. 'In principle' ko dhyan mein rakhein: supplied text practical restrictions ka detail nahi deta. [p004]
